title.narrative: Community-Driven Lifesaving WASH Response Services for Crisis-Affected and Marginalized Populations in Jowhar District, Middle Shabelle Region

description.narrative: ltpgtAMARD proposes a lifesaving, inclusive, and protection-sensitive WASH intervention in Jowhar District, Middle Shabelle Region, targeting rural villages and flood-prone communities affected by recurrent flooding, climate variability, displacement pressures, and long-standing exclusion from basic services. The project focuses on underserved host communities, minority groups, and vulnerable households whose access to safe water and sanitation remains critically constrained, increasing public health and protection risks.ltbrgtThe intervention is fully aligned with the Somalia Humanitarian Fund (SHF) Flagship District approach and responds directly to priorities identified through the SHF Community Engagement (CE) process, which highlighted unsafe water sources, inadequate sanitation, long travel distances to water points, and limited accountability mechanisms as key drivers of vulnerability in rural Jowhar. By applying an area-based, community-validated approach, the project seeks to address urgent WASH needs while preventing avoidable displacement and strengthening community resilience at points of origin.ltbrgtThe project will improve equitable access to safe and reliable water through targeted rehabilitation and upgrading of community water systems. Key activities include expansion of village water systems through additional storage capacity, upgrading of solar pumping components, rehabilitation of water catchments, extension of water pipelines, and construction of a freshwater borehole with elevated storage and distribution. These investments are designed to increase water availability, improve system reliability, and ensure functionality during seasonal shocks.ltbrgtTo address sanitation and protection risks, the project will construct flood-resilient, gender-segregated, and disability-inclusive latrines in Ali-Warabay. Facilities will incorporate raised platforms, safe access, privacy, and accessibility features to ensure dignified use by women, girls, older persons, and persons with disabilities in flood-prone settings. Sanitation improvements will be complemented by community-based hygiene promotion and behaviour change activities focusing on safe water handling, sanitation practices, prevention of waterborne diseases, and menstrual hygiene management.ltbrgtSustainability and quality assurance are embedded through the establishment and strengthening of inclusive community WASH committees, supported with training on operation and maintenance, minor repairs, financial management, and transparent tariff setting. Routine water quality testing and monitoring will be conducted across all supported water sources to ensure safety and maintain community confidence in improved services.ltbrgtProtection mainstreaming is integrated across all components. The project will implement strong Accountability to Affected People (AAP) mechanisms, including accessible feedback channels, information sharing, and responsive complaint handling. Safeguarding, Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), and disability inclusion measures will be systematically applied to ensure WASH services do not exacerbate protection risks and remain accessible to all. Continuous community engagement and validation meetings will be conducted throughout implementation to maintain alignment with community priorities and adapt activities as needed.ltbrgtAMARD brings strong operational capacity, local acceptance, and a proven track record in Jowhar District, including prior SHF-funded WASH interventions. Through locally recruited teams, active participation in Area-Based Coordination and WASH Cluster structures, and consistent submission of 5Ws, AMARD will ensure coordinated, accountable, and high-quality delivery. The project directly contributes to Strategic Objective 2 by sustaining lives through equitable access to basic services and Strategic Objective 3 by mitigating protection risks associated with unsafe WASH access, exclusion, and lack of accountability.ltbrgtlt/pgt
